lastResponse.text: Absolutely. Quiet options: have one trusted person do live check-ins by text only, with short code words, and no voicemail. Ask workplace security or a known coworker to walk her directly to a preplanned pickup spot. For a fast exit, use a rideshare only from a safe indoor Place, and turn off trip sharing if he could see it. Keep contacts limited to two people she trusts. If danger turns immediate, call nine one one, nine-one-one.
